# Fixed evaluation prompts for LoRA checkpoint comparison.
# Used by scripts/generate.py --eval. Seeds are fixed (1000 + index),
# so the same prompt+seed grid is produced for every checkpoint/model.
# Do not edit casually: changing this file breaks comparability with
# past evaluations. Anima uses [tags]; the other models use [natural].

[natural]
okakikai. A girl with long silver hair and a red ribbon, wearing a white dress, standing in a garden full of flowers and smiling.
okakikai. A girl with short pink hair in a school uniform, sitting in a classroom by the window and holding a book.
okakikai. A blonde girl wearing a white beret and a white sweater, seen from the waist up in a cafe, holding a cup and looking at the viewer.
okakikai. Two girls, one with black hair and one with a purple ponytail, in casual clothes, walking down a shopping street carrying bags.
okakikai. A girl with brown twintails wearing an apron, cooking in a kitchen and holding a frying pan with steam rising from it.
okakikai. A chibi girl with pink hair in pajamas, sitting on a bed at night and hugging a plush toy, with the moon visible through the window.
